brief.claim: Mussel growth increases with the amount of food supplement given to a tank: the regression slope of growth on the supplement dose is positive, at the one-sided 0.05 level.

data_keys.meaning: supplement dose assigned to each tank
shell growth of each measured mussel, in the tank given by the first axis

brief.sizes: 12 tanks, 8 mussels per tank (96 growth values).
